<img src="/assets/images/headshots/headshot_dkaiser.jpg" width="20%" hspace="20" align="left">
I am a Post-Doctoral researcher working with <a href="https://nwlandry.com">Dr. Nicholas Landry</a> at the <a href="https://eebvirginia.org">University of Virginia's Biology Department</a>. 

My current research interests revolve around understanding multi-body competition complexity and higher-order signatures of social contagion; you can read more about my work on my ["Projects"](pages/research/projects.qmd) or ["Publications"](pages/research/publications.qmd) pages.

I am passionate about teaching and mentoring as well; you can find a list of courses I am currently teaching and have taught in the past on my ["Teaching"](pages/teaching/teaching.qmd) page, as well as a list of students I have mentored in research on my ["Mentoring"](pages/teaching/mentoring.qmd).

Feel free to reach out with any questions or just to chat! Below you can find links to my relevant contacts and profiles.
